notes: Issue #24 recorded corpus of permitted HTTP-only extraction outcomes and Reddit use cases. Record shapes follow the issue scope: an ordinary permitted static page (HTTP baseline), a genuinely HTTP-inaccessible but permitted-to-render JavaScript-only page (the capability probe the issue requires), a blocked Reddit discussion reached only through the #17 snippet/submission paths, and an anti-abuse interstitial. Every HTTP response is a recorded fixture; no live fetch, no browser launch. Browser renders, declared costs and refusals are recorded so the replay is deterministic.

records.useCase: A genuinely HTTP-inaccessible but permitted-to-render page: the server returns a JavaScript shell and only a browser render produces the report text.
records.groundingNote: No unavailable extraction result or submitted-but-unreadable URL in the recorded deployment evidence is attributable to a permitted JavaScript-only page: recorded unavailable outcomes are access-restricted pages and no-public-URL items. This record measures the capability envelope the issue asks about; it does not evidence an observed pipeline loss.

browser.renderedBody:
Atlas-9 Maintenance Report

The Atlas-9 maintenance window introduced a revised gait-controller calibration profile and restored nominal stance damping within the recorded tolerance band.

Reliability

The fleet logging posture shows 42 days between recorded maintenance interventions, up from 17 days, with no furnace-cycle regressions filed against the revision.

records.useCase: A Reddit discussion discovered through the permitted paths (search snippets, notifications, manual submission): plain HTTP is blocked by the platform's anti-abuse controls and must stay unavailable rather than trigger circumvention.
records.groundingNote: Issue #17 recorded the permitted Reddit discovery paths: search-snippet discovery and manual submissions with snippet-level provenance, with post-ID identity merging search results, notification emails and submissions into one canonical item. The blocked body stays unavailable with its snippet provenance; Reddit access is never recovered by browser rendering.
records.permittedBasis: Reddit serves the discussion behind an anti-abuse control wall that blocks plain HTTP retrieval; retrieving the blocked body through a browser would circumvent a platform/anti-abuse restriction, which AGENTS.md and D11 prohibit regardless of technical reachability.

records.useCase: A permitted-origin page that gates readers behind a human-verification challenge: the shipped HTTP extractor already records it as an interstitial, and no browser render may resolve or bypass the challenge.
records.groundingNote: Interstitial anti-abuse controls are common where operators do not want automated reading; the shipped extractor already records these pages unavailable rather than attempting a bypass. Recorded to pin the boundary: a browser render that resolves or dodges the challenge is circumvention and stays unrecoverable.
records.permittedBasis: Access requires defeating an anti-abuse human-verification challenge, which is both the operator's automation prohibition and a control circumvention; a render that solved or dodged it would violate D11 regardless of technical reachability.
